excerpts: Exported from the identity provider and reconciled by the CISO on 2026-09-01.
accepted.addresses: The document is a register of granted access rights listing person, systems, role, grant date and approver; it does not show how often the register is maintained beyond the single reconciliation date.
Each access grant records who approved it (CEO or CISO), bearing on authorisation by relevant persons; it does not show the authorisation procedure itself.

The register shows role-scoped access (operator limited to portal and backups, administrator on all systems), bearing on least privilege; it does not state need-to-know, separation of duties principles or revocation.
